info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Commissions API
info.description: The Manage Commissions API facilitates the updating of commission details for sales transactions in the banking domain. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can modify existing commission records based on specific commission IDs. This is particularly useful for financial institutions and sales teams aiming to ensure accurate commission structures and maintain compliance with regulatory standards. Typical consumers include financial analysts and sales administrators who require efficient means to adjust commission information in their systems.

patch.summary: Update commission details for a specific sales resource.
patch.description: This operation allows you to modify the commission details for the specified sales resource identified by its unique identifier. Ensure that the request body contains the appropriate fields for updating the commission information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the commission details for a specific sale identified by the RES-100045 reference. It allows for partial updates to commission data, ensuring that only the necessary fields need to be provided, while null values can be used to indicate fields that should be cleared.
